name: yacht_halyard_tick
prompt: Inside the cabin of a small sailing yacht at anchor at night: a loose halyard gently tapping against the aluminium mast, a few soft hollow metallic ticks and one light clink, carried down the mast into the quiet cabin, with silence between them. Only the halyard taps, no wind, no music, no voices, dry, single source.

name: yacht_halyard_rattle
prompt: A gust passes over a small sailing yacht at anchor: a halyard slaps and rattles quickly against the hollow aluminium mast for a few seconds, then settles to slow taps, heard from inside the cabin below. Only the halyard on the mast, no music, no voices, dry, single source.

name: yacht_chain_grumble
prompt: A small yacht swinging slowly at anchor: the anchor chain grinds and grumbles over the bow roller and drags along the sandy seabed, a low gritty rumble of steel links with a couple of soft clanks, heard muffled from inside the forward cabin. Single sound, no engine, no windlass motor, no music, no voices, dry.

name: yacht_cabin_creak
prompt: Inside the wooden cabin of a small sailing yacht rocking gently at anchor: one slow soft creak of wooden joinery and fibreglass as the boat rolls, low and close. Single sound, no footsteps, no door, no music, no voices, dry.

name: yacht_hull_cluck
prompt: Small waves clucking under the hull of a fibreglass sailing yacht at anchor, heard from inside the cabin right at the waterline: one hollow wet plop and a short gurgle against the hull, very close. Single sound, no music, no voices, dry.
